description: Pirate Nest: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: Pirates have taken over a hulk in {system} and use it as a base. {client} wants it cleared. Expect fighters and a handful of gunships. They will call friends if it goes badly.
A nest of {enemy} in {system}. {client} would like it burned. The pirates will fight and then run. Do not let them run.
There is a pirate den near {station}. {client} pays for every ship you kill. Start with the gunships.
success: The nest is clean. {client} pays {captain} and the local traders leave a bottle at the dock for you.
Pirates dead and base cold. {client} pays and drops the matter.
Nothing left of the den. {client} pays and expects to be asked again in six months.
failure: The pirates are still there and now they know your name. {client} pays nothing.
You are beaten off. The nest remains. {client} withdraws the offer.
radio-guards: Nest in sight. Fighters on patrol, two gunships. Do not stop shooting.
Contacts. They have seen us. Weapons free.
Pirate patrol. They are not subtle.
radio-friends: Their friends are arriving. Four fighters and a frigate.
More pirates, right. The frigate is an old hull but it still bites.
Reinforcements from the nest. They had a frigate hiding.
radio-runners: The rest are bolting. Chase them.
Pirates scattering. Do not let them go.
